evidence.label: annual competitive grants
evidence.quote: (a) Grant authorization.—For each of fiscal years 2027 through 2032, the Secretary shall award, on a competitive basis, grants to eligible entities to provide student services to increase participation, retention, and completion rates of high-need students.

evidence.label: eligible applicants
evidence.quote:
(4) Eligible entity.—The term eligible entity means—
(A) a public institution of higher education;
(B) a partnership between a nonprofit educational organization and an institution of higher education; or
(C) a consortium of institutions of higher education.

evidence.label: tribal reservation, total annual appropriation
evidence.quote: From the total amount appropriated to carry out this Act for a fiscal year, the Secretary shall reserve 2 percent for grants to eligible Indian entities to increase participation, retention, and completion rates of high-need students.

evidence.label: evidence tier reservation, remaining annual appropriation
evidence.quote: (d) Evidence-Based student success programs.—From the total amount appropriated to carry out this Act for a fiscal year and not reserved under section 4, the Secretary shall reserve not less than 20 percent to award grants to eligible entities with applications that propose to include evidence-based reforms and practices—

evidence.label: administration cap
evidence.quote: (1) not more than 5 percent for administration, capacity building, research, evaluation, and reporting; and

evidence.label: technical assistance cap
evidence.quote: (2) not more than 2 percent for technical assistance to eligible entities and eligible Indian entities.
